doc: The same comma ascent at age 1.3 with float32 directions: the head and the center are cast to float32 and the distances computed in float32, so the output is float32. Tolerance rtol 2e-5, atol 2e-6: the float64-promoted computation differs by at most 2.5e-7, a one-ulp nudge of the directions by 6e-7 (0.10 of the default band); tolerance 10 times that, rounded up. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).

params.dtype_chain: p float32: the center, the east and pole vectors and the head are computed in float64 and the head is cast to float32 (p.dtype); the distances, the exp and the dry slot are float32.
